text:
maria: Heads-up — starting bring-up of q6b-int4-v2 on staging. Need promptset curation + golden checks before we flip traffic. Focus surfaces: instruction-following, codegen snippets, and RAG retrieval prompts. Can we triage overlap with current promptbank, dedupe impact, and labeler capacity? ping @alex @jonathan @sara :eyes:

alex: On it. I'll run an overlap scan against the promptbank. How big is the canary we're expecting? And what's the target quality SLO (delta) we accept?

maria: Canary ~5k stratified (50% instruction, 25% codegen, 25% RAG/long-context). Latency looks ~25% better token throughput in perf run. Quality delta target: <=1.5% drop worst-case on golden pass rate, otherwise we need mitigation.

jonathan: Quick dedupe scan shows ~28% near-duplicates (cos_sim > 0.92) with our existing bank — that's high. Query I used: `SELECT sample_id, cos_sim FROM overlaps WHERE cos_sim > 0.92 ORDER BY cos_sim DESC LIMIT 10000;` If we aggressively dedupe we risk losing rare intents. Proposal: dedupe cutoff 0.97 for samples flagged as "rare_intent" tag, 0.92 otherwise. I can share the script.

sara: Label ops: current open queue 1,189 (per label-bot), 3 annotators active, avg throughput ~200/day. We can prioritize 500 canary items for golden labeling if we freeze everything else. Someone needs to open a golden-update PR to lock the set and record provenance.

kevin: Bench notes: overall latency improvement :white_check_mark:, but instruction-following subset shows regression: pass@1 down ~3.4% on the quick harness. Likely quant kernel schedule + kv-cache alignment. Suggest running microbenches for int4 vs int8 and also an eval subset: `eval-harness --subset instruction --models q6b-int4-v2,q6b-int8-v1 --metrics pass@1,exact_match` to isolate.

alex: I'll produce an overlap CSV + candidate dedupe decisions by EOD. Also will run tokenizer sanity (we had token-shift incidents previously) using `tokenizer-check --model q6b-int4-v2 --compare baseline-v1`.

sara: For golden composition: propose 150 micro-golden additions (hard negatives) selected from items where baseline and new model disagree most. Those give higher signal for regressions rather than random sampling.

maria: Agree to micro-golden. Also want per-route telemetry so we can map failures to prompt shape (length, role tokens, presence of code blocks). @kevin can you add quick panels for that?

kevin: Yup — will add panels to canary dashboard: `model_eval_instruction_fail_rate`, `token_latency_p50`, `token_latency_p95`, and a tag-breakdown by `prompt_shape` dimension. Will also run the int4/int8 microbench and post results.

label-bot: label-bot: queue update — 1189 open, 3 active annotators, est throughput 200/day. Prioritized 500 items ETA 3 days. If we need <48h turnaround we should spin up 2 contractors.

jonathan: Alternative to speed: I can synthetic-augment ~200 paraphrases for rare intents (paraphrase-gen temp=0.9) to preserve coverage if we dedupe aggressively. That'll give us signal without adding to labeling backlog immediately.

maria: Action items summary (agree?):
1) alex -> overlap CSV + dedupe-scoped candidate list (EOD)
2) jonathan -> run synthetic augment for rares + share dedupe-adjust script
3) sara -> open golden-update PR, allocate 500 prioritized items to labellers
4) kevin -> add dashboard panels + run int4/int8 microbench and post results
5) label-bot -> if ETA >2 days request 2 contractors from people-ops

Let's reconvene Thu 10:00am PT to review canary eval and decide whether to broaden rollouts. Thanks :thumbsup:

maria: minor note — keep a pinned log of failing prompts (gist or internal S3) so SRE and support can cross-check incidents quickly.
